payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterates over camels, checking each new camel against all previously seen camels for mutual spit condition.
payload.rationale: The solution performs a brute-force pairwise check (complete search) but does not use backtracking, bitmask, branch-and-bound, or graph search. Closest subtype is permutation enumeration as it involves examining pairs, though not generating permutations.
